claims.claim: Mango wall hair dryer for salons.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a branded Mango wall-mounted salon-style heat/massage dryer unit with front controls and a hood/arm.

claims.claim: 6 months of use and in a very perfect condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show the exterior and controls, but do not confirm usage duration or overall condition beyond visible surfaces.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of purchase date; witness report does not include receipt/warranty images.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show internal condition or whether it operates correctly; no function test is shown.
Witness report lists these as not shown; no receipt/warranty images included.

risks.risk: It may not power on or may not heat/dry properly (hidden electrical/heating faults).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on, fan/motor running, and heat output working (thermostat/heating indicator if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested/possible non-working or intermittent operation.

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues (wrong voltage, missing fuse/overheat protection, damaged wiring).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating label/specs (voltage/wattage) plus a close-up of the power inlet/cable and any fuse/thermal cut-off markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for safety/compatibility uncertainty.

risks.risk: Cosmetic or structural wear not fully visible (hood/arm joints, cracks, loose mounting, worn cables).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the hood/arm joints, mounting points, and the full cable/cord length (including strain relief).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible wear consistent with used equipment.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/attachments or incorrect mounting hardware.
risks.proof: A photo inventory showing all included parts (mounting bracket, screws/anchors, any attachments/nozzles) laid out and matched to the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories may be missing.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch or incorrect identification (photos show Mango, but exact model not confirmed).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full model number/serial number plate on the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic Mango wall salon dryer without confirmed model.

proof_requests: Send a short video showing the unit powering on and heating/drying correctly (fan + heat working).
Provide clear photos of the rating/spec label (voltage, wattage, model/serial number).
Show close-ups of the power inlet/cable and any fuse/overheat protection markings.
Provide close-up photos of hood/arm joints and mounting points for cracks/looseness.
Upload images of the receipt and warranty card (front and back if applicable).
List and photograph all included accessories/attachments and mounting hardware.
response.reason: The witness report consistently identifies a Mango wall-mounted salon heat/dryer unit with controls and hood/arm, so it can be priced at its worst-case used/untested scenario. However, operation, safety, and completeness are not proven by the photos, so the price should reflect those uncertainties.
